notes: The margin's *a prince* was read and set aside under rule 38.

`אִישׁ מַתָּן` is one nominal the ASV recasts as a head noun plus a relative clause of giving, so rule 46's closing paragraph keeps the supplied antecedent, relative and verb in `אִישׁ`'s unit; the head goes on the English verb the recasting writes, as rule 43 heads `בַּעַל כְּנָפַיִם` on *hath*. Heading on the supplied *him* was the competing reading.
The article on `רֵעַ` is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes *a friend*, and the phrase's *the* before *liberal man* is a supplied determiner on the anarthrous substantive.
